name: study-pilot
description: Windows authorized webpage automation desktop app

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win nsis --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build-android-bridge.mjs && npx cap sync android && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist/android-webview-bridge.js','android/app/src/main/assets/android-webview-bridge.js')"
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:dev: npm run build && npx cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && node scripts/build-android-bridge.mjs && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist/android-webview-bridge.js','android/app/src/main/assets/android-webview-bridge.js')" && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat :app:clean :app:assembleDebug --no-build-cache
scripts.android:release: npm run build && node scripts/build-android-bridge.mjs && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist/android-webview-bridge.js','android/app/src/main/assets/android-webview-bridge.js')" && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat :app:clean :app:assembleRelease --no-build-cache

author: Antigravity
